{
  "participants": [
    {
      "login": "ajtowns",
      "stance": "objection",
      "note": "objected to bottom-to-top callback API and raised potential lifetime issues with raw pointers to structure internals"
    },
    {
      "login": "yuvicc",
      "stance": "neutral",
      "note": "suggested exposing witness stack serialization instead of a callback API (#36911)"
    },
    {
      "login": "stickies-v",
      "stance": "support",
      "note": "Approach ACK; suggested storing item offsets instead of spans in WitnessStack"
    },
    {
      "login": "nervana21",
      "stance": "support",
      "note": "Concept ACK"
    }
  ],
  "claims": [
    {
      "id": "c:7000400977",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "expose the witness stack's serialization instead of adding a callback type to the API",
      "quote": "Instead of adding a new callback type to the API, we could expose the witness stack's serialization, e.g. btck_witness_stack_to_bytes",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "author answered that the callback was dropped in favor of array outputs and will review PR #36911",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:7001406224"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "c:7001406224",
      "status_by_quote": "The latest push drops the callback. The function now writes every item's pointer and size into two arrays passed to it."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:4624098545",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "interface",
      "text": "processing the witness stack from bottom to top treats it like a queue rather than a stack and is the wrong API",
      "quote": "This processes the witness stack from the bottom to the top, treating it more like a queue than a stack. Doesn't really feel the right API to me?",
      "clears_with": "change",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author pushed 9d0f1d05bd to return arrays of pointers and sizes readable from either end",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:4624575925",
        "rc:4624936766"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:4624936766",
      "status_by_quote": "I switched to this shape in 9d0f1d05bd. I feel much better about this approach."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:4637893873",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "safety",
      "text": "passing back pointers to structure internals introduces lifetime issues if the caller keeps items around longer than the witness stack",
      "quote": "It also potentially introduces lifetime issues, in case the caller keeps `items` around longer than the corresponding `WitnessStack`?",
      "clears_with": "change",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author pushed 4a30676 to drop get_items and return an owned copy",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:4639034578",
        "rc:4642779024",
        "rc:4696805650"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "c:7200258528",
      "status_by_quote": "get_items is now gone. btck_WitnessStack keeps a span for each item, which makes btck_witness_stack_get_item_at O(1), an"
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:4639374101",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "hide raw pointers in an opaque owned Handle type or cache spans in the witness wrapper",
      "quote": "I think any raw pointers should be hidden in an opaque Handle type, and owned (or wrapped in `shared_ptr`)?",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author pushed 4a30676 returning an owned copy",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:4642779024",
        "rc:4696805650"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "c:7200258528",
      "status_by_quote": "btck_transaction_input_get_witness_stack returns an owned copy."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:4696210491",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "interface",
      "text": "avoid leaking the implementation into the interface by returning an owned object rather than raw pointers",
      "quote": "It's better to avoid leaking the implementation into the interface, and it seems to me like here we can easily do this.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "accepted",
      "status_note": "author proposed returning an owned object and stickies-v accepted the approach",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:4696805650"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "rc:4696972813",
      "status_by_quote": "Sounds good."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:4696972813",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "wait to open the PR until prerequisite witness stack changes are merged",
      "quote": "I think it would have made more sense to open this PR after/when the witness stack changes get merged. At this point, it's all speculation, and not the best use of time imo.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "author agreed to follow that approach and asked about draft PR usage in the repo; prerequisite #36895 has since merged",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:4697841677"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "rc:4697841677",
      "status_by_quote": "I appreciate the feedback and would be happy to follow that approach."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:4722455120",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "store item offsets instead of spans in WitnessStack to simplify copy and move semantics and reduce memory usage",
      "quote": "An alternative would be to store offsets. It's a bit more code, but I think it's more idiomatic, and it also halves the memory footprint per item on 64-bit platforms (16 to 8 bytes).",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "open",
      "status_note": "",
      "author_replies": [],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "",
      "status_by_quote": ""
    }
  ],

    }

  "notes": "stickies-v provided an Approach ACK and suggested storing item offsets instead of spans in WitnessStack to simplify copy/move operations and halve item memory footprint.",

      "on": "author",
      "what": "respond to stickies-v's suggestion to store item offsets in WitnessStack",
